## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences, and the issue it closes, for example "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

<!-- The pull request title follows Conventional Commits, for example "fix(core): ...". -->

- [ ] `fix`: a bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: a new capability
- [ ] `perf` or `refactor`: behaviour unchanged
- [ ] `docs`, `test`, `chore` or `ci`
- [ ] Breaking change (the migration is described below)

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm format:check` pass locally.
- [ ] Behaviour changes have tests; storage changes have an assertion in the `KnowledgeBackend` contract suite.
- [ ] It works with no account, no API key and no network.
- [ ] The documentation is updated, if behaviour changed.
